title: Service transport protocol token
reason:
Provisional source-informed meaning. No canonical MeaningGraph entry or accepted equivalence; fresh Phase2 reconciliation required.

Phase 2 UNRESOLVED: Stop, platform, station, locality, route, trip and service day are distinct. Keys are authority/feed/version scoped; NaPTAN ATCO, NaptanCode, NPTG, ORR NLC/TLC, GTFS stop_id and WIGOS must never be equated by spelling. Schedules describe supply, annual rail usage is an estimate, and geography/weather associations do not establish station identity. Definition gap: the candidate combines source roles or lacks a sufficiently bounded reusable definition and binding domain. Retain the candidate; do not infer absence from literal query results.
